treatment_summary: Start ramipril 2.5 mg daily (titrate to 5 mg) and atorvastatin 20 mg nightly as first‑line therapy for hypertension and cardiovascular risk. Initiate metformin 500 mg daily pending normal renal function, with titration to full dose. Offer semaglutide for weight loss if patient consents and BMI ≥30 kg/m². Continue existing hydrochlorothiazide and vitamin B12 while monitoring potassium, renal function, and liver enzymes. Obtain missing labs (eGFR, LFTs, lipids, QRISK) and review in 2–4 weeks.
